programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana - Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).

programme.title: Mozart - Sérénade en si bémol majeur dite Gran Partita
programme.desc: Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Dvořák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova and Friends: Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: Pianist Elena Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Felix Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. This performance was recorded at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany, in November 2020.

programme.title: The Cleveland Orchestra - Mozart & Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer and Budapest Festival Orchestra: Beethoven Evening
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43 - Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9 (Mineria)
programme.desc: Mahler's 9th Symphony captivates through its profound emotional depth and vulnerability, especially the breathtakingly beautiful and spiritually resonant Adagio that concludes the work, offering a profound sense of closure and transcendence.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7 (Mineria)
programme.desc: Unusual Orchestral Colors and Effects. The use of less common instruments and the fresh soundscapes Mahler creates, lead to a rich and unique listening experience.

programme.title: One Concert to Rule them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana - Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).

programme.title: Schubert: Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: 6153_Beauty_is_a_Crime
programme.desc: Conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance of works by Brahms and Mendelssohn, showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Dvořák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Gershwin Greatest Hits - Concertgebouw Brugge
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Argerich and Friends in Chantilly (Beethoven, Saint-Saens)
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï. They perform with the orchestra Les Siècles under the baton of Romanian-Austrian conductor Ion Marin. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux). This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 4, 2021.

programme.title: Michelle Candotti - CMIM Piano 2024 - Chamber Music
programme.desc: Pianist Michelle Candotti (Italy, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Brandenburg Concertos (Collegium 1704, Václav Luks)
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8 - Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand". Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, 2017.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies - National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major - Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last purely instrumental piece in 1791. This piece was his Clarinet Concerto in A major which he wrote for his friend Anton Stadler. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts.

programme.title: John Eliot Gardiner conducts Tchaikovsky and Elgar
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian’, and Edward Elgar’s Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Quintet in E-flat, KV 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. This performance was recorded at Perugia’s Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms - Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition.

programme.title: LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute (soloist is Gareth Davies), and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke’s in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala - Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky: Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a pleasing performance of Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 - the 'Little Russian'. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's London on May 31st, 2021.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) - Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival 2014. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church. The Goldberg Variations consists of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg.

programme.title: Juan Diego Flórez and the Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko Recital: Mozart, Ravel and Rachmaninov
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward conducts Dvořák
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony - Legends & Quests
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Chiesa & Baglini - Busoni, Liszt, Chopin & Rachmaninoff
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: Galaxymphony strikes back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven Symphony No 5
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Gershwin Greatest Hits - Concertgebouw Brugge
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: The Cleveland Orchestra - Mozart & Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg.

programme.title: Concert of Magic and Fire
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8 - Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand". Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, 2017.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer and Budapest Festival Orchestra: Beethoven Evening
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. On the program are ‘Genoveva’ Overture, Op. 81; Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; and Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms - Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition.

programme.title: Descent into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström’ (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass’s work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) - Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival 2014. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church. The Goldberg Variations consists of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8 - Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand". Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, 2017.

programme.title: Programme Johann Sebastian Bach - Concertgebouw Brugge
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij. The program continues with a fine selection of Bach’s works performed by French lutenist Thomas Dunford. This concert was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

programme.title: Gershwin Greatest Hits - Concertgebouw Brugge
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9 (Mineria)
programme.desc: Mahler's 9th Symphony captivates through its profound emotional depth and vulnerability, especially the breathtakingly beautiful and spiritually resonant Adagio that concludes the work, offering a profound sense of closure and transcendence.

programme.title: One Concert to Rule them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala - Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms - Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) - Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival 2014. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church. The Goldberg Variations consists of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer conducts Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Florentino
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program featuring Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338, and Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8 - Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand". Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, 2017.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Mozart's Linz
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky: Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a pleasing performance of Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 - the 'Little Russian'. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's London on May 31st, 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Complete String Quartets IV
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Daniel Harding conducts Brahms and Mahler
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children.

programme.title: 6153_Beauty_is_a_Crime
programme.desc: Conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance of works by Brahms and Mendelssohn, showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Liszt/Wagner - Isolde's Liebestod
programme.desc: Italian pianist Costantino Catena performs Franz Liszt’s transcription of ‘Isoldens Liebestod’ from Richard Wagner’s opera ‘Tristan und Isolde’. This performance was recorded at the Church of the Jesuit College in Trapani, Italy.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust plays Bach
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna - The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2 - Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43 - Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel & Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Dvořák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana - Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).

programme.title: John Eliot Gardiner conducts Tchaikovsky and Elgar
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian’, and Edward Elgar’s Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major - Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last purely instrumental piece in 1791. This piece was his Clarinet Concerto in A major which he wrote for his friend Anton Stadler. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts.

programme.title: Juan Diego Flórez and the Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova and Friends: Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: Pianist Elena Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Felix Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. This performance was recorded at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany, in November 2020.

programme.title: Music in the Air

To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Gewandhausorchester Leipzig: Mozart / Voříšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504, also know as the 'Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Gewandhausorchester Leipzig: Mozart / Voříšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504, also know as the 'Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Les Dissonances and leading violinist David Grimal by Symphony No. 8 by Ludwig van Beethoven at the Opéra Dijon in France. The symphony is distinguished by its simplicity and its overall duration, which returns to the classical proportions of Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Prokofiev & Stravinsky – Budapest Festival Orchestra & Ivan Fischer
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. On the program are Prokofiev's Ouverture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34 and Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63, and Stravinsky's Jeu de Cartes and Firebird Suite No. 2.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada conducts Fauré’s Requiem in Basilique Saint-Sernin
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others.

programme.title: Beethoven Symphony No 5
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Quintet in E-flat, KV 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. This performance was recorded at Perugia’s Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko Recital: Mozart, Ravel and Rachmaninov
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Daniel Harding conducts Brahms and Mahler
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies - National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Beethoven - Complete String Quartets V
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Beethoven & Berlioz
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Into the Wild (Grieg & Beethoven) - Concertgebouw Brugge
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 3 (Mineria)
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies - National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl’s Best Friend’, from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things’ from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow’ from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River’ from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko Recital: Mozart, Ravel and Rachmaninov
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala - Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony - Legends & Quests
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) - Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival 2014. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church. The Goldberg Variations consists of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg.

programme.title: LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute (soloist is Gareth Davies), and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke’s in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Schubert: Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43 - Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7 (Mineria)
programme.desc: Unusual Orchestral Colors and Effects. The use of less common instruments and the fresh soundscapes Mahler creates, lead to a rich and unique listening experience.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky Recital: Beethoven, Glazunov, Bach, Rachmaninov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: 6153_Beauty_is_a_Crime
programme.desc: Conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance of works by Brahms and Mendelssohn, showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: The Cleveland Orchestra - Mozart & Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit - Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap & Alex Wilson
programme.desc: The "Solo Piano Summit" brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke Trio & Don Byas, Art Simmons Trio
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. The line-up consists of Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke Trio with Don Byas, and the Art Simmons Trio.

programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals.

programme.desc: On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Fannie Mae

programme.desc: Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres.

programme.title: Kenny Barron at Lviv Ukraine 2019

programme.title: Christian Scott at Sofia Bulgaria 2019

programme.desc: Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday tells us the story of one of jazz’s greatest singers ever. Colleagues such as Carmen McRae, Annie Ross, Mal Waldron, Buck Clayton, Harry “Sweets” Edison, and Milt Gabler offer their first-hand perspectives.

programme.desc: This live recording is celebrating 50 years of West Coast Jazz. The West Coast Jazz movement had its origins about 50 years ago in Los Angeles. It was essentially a "cool" form of jazz played mostly by studio musicians as a break from their studio work.

programme.desc: In 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley’), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

programme.desc: Experience the wilderness of New Zealand’s oldest national park with raw landscape framed by snow-capped mountains.

programme.title: Cascading Waterfall: Indonesia
programme.desc: Take a trip through the Indonesian jungle to a remote waterfall cascading over a natural cave.

programme.title: Nusa Penida: Indonesia
programme.desc: Travel to Bali and enjoy a breathtaking bird’s eye view of the lush coastline.

programme.title: Whiritoa Beach
programme.desc: Discover the raw beauty of this secluded New Zealand beach, surrounded by wildflowers.

programme.title: Spirit Lake Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Relax at the gorgeous Spirit Lake, in Mount St Helen's Washington with this soothing dynamic nature film containing only the pure sounds of Nature!

programme.title: Playa Fronton: Dominican Republic
programme.desc: Feel the sand beneath your feet as you enjoy the soft lapping of waves on this tropical beach.

programme.title: World's Best Beaches
programme.desc: The world's most beautiful beaches, paired with melodies to soothe the soul.

programme.title: Above & Below the Caribbean
programme.desc: Relax as you float above and below the surface of a beautiful underwater kelp forest in the Caribbean, with this stunning 1 hour static scene featuring swimming fish, passing clouds, and sunshine glistening. Filmed by Tilo & Yvonne Kühnast.

programme.title: Flying Over Scotland
programme.desc: Soar over the lush green landscape and enchanting waters of Scotland in a bird’s-eye view voyage.

programme.title: South Island Lakes: New Zealand
programme.desc: South Island of New Zealand is renowned for its breathtaking lakes. Sit down. relax and enjoy the view!

programme.title: Nelson Lake & Te Anau Lake: New Zealand
programme.desc: Rolling hills, glacial lakes, vast skies, and awe-inspiring forests and mountains make up the breathtaking scenery of the Nelson and Te Anu lakes of New Zealand.

programme.title: Tumpak Sewu Waterfalls: East Java
programme.desc: Dare to dream of standing at the edge of the tiered, plunging streams of Indonesia's Tumpak Sewu falls. You'll be so close that you will practically feel the mist on your face.

programme.title: Remote Wetland: Louisiana
programme.desc: Enjoy the stillness of a secluded wetland deep in the Southern United States.

programme.title: Tutoko River: New Zealand
programme.desc: Follow the rushing waters through rocky rapids, and enjoy scenic views of lush mountains.

programme.title: Above & Under
programme.desc: Fly above beachy shores and dive deep into the crystal-clear waters brimming with sea creatures.

programme.title: Cadlao Lagoon: Philippines
programme.desc: Experience the stunning beauty of a turquoise lagoon flanked by impressive, vegetation-covered mountains.

programme.title: Santa Ynez Valley: California
programme.desc: Take a walk in the idyllic valley and enjoy calming sights of mature trees, and endless skies.

programme.title: Mount Cook: New Zealand
programme.desc: Take in the rugged beauty of snow-capped mountains and calm emerald waters.

programme.title: Moalboal White Beach: Philippines
programme.desc: Known to locals as Basdaku Beach, the name translates to "big sand," and it's no surprise why. Step into this expansive, white sandy beach of crystal clear waters and lose yourself in the never-ending kaleidoscope horizon of changing hues.

programme.title: Healing Hawaii II: Oahu
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the Hawaiian Island of Oahu.

programme.title: Tropical Beaches: Indonesia
programme.desc: Journey to a remote Indonesian island and experience the breathtaking scenery of various beaches.

programme.title: A Day in Mt Rainier 2
programme.desc: Spend 2 hours slowly journeying to some of the most beautiful and hidden sections of the famous Mount Rainier National Park, in Washington state with nothing but the pure nature sounds for total relaxation.

programme.title: Tropical Weightlessness
programme.desc: Gently sway in the tropical turquoise waters with a glimpse of blue sky and palm trees.

programme.title: Tranquil Tide: Côte d'Azur
programme.desc: Visit the medieval town of Menton on the French Cote d’Azur, where the sun glistens on the iridescent water.

programme.title: Autumnal River: Hoh River
programme.desc: Mossy rocks and golden leaves frame rushing waters, in this autumnal escape.

programme.title: Lush Vineyards: Portugal
programme.desc: Escape to the jaw-droppingly beautiful Douro Valley, Portugal’s most scenic wine regions.

programme.title: Donde Nacen Los Pobres
programme.desc: Jesús y Blanca provienen de mundos opuestos: Jesús, un hombre humilde que ha trabajado duro para sobrevivir, y Blanca, una mujer rica a la que la desgracia la ha llevado a un lugar de vulnerabilidad, sus vidas se cruzan en un amor inesperado.

programme.title: La Noche es Nuestra
programme.desc: Una historia de amor conmovedora y auténtica. Ellos tendrán que enfrentarse al mundo para aprovechar aquella noche.

programme.title: Con Amor de Muerte
programme.desc: Los pasajeros de un avión cuyo vuelo ha sufrido un retraso se hospedan en un hotel. Llega una joven de pelo castaño, bebe en el bar varios vodkas para darse valor, se insinúa a un viajero y hace el amor con él. El viajero descubre con sorpresa que ella ha sacrificado su virginidad. La joven no quiere dar su nombre ni saber el del viajero y se cerciora de que él seguirá su viaje, sin esperanzas de volverla a ver.

programme.title: La Fuerza De Los Humildes
programme.desc: Un acaudalado industrial se encuentra en conflicto con sus obreros. Su hija está en desacuerdo con los métodos del padre, pues se encuentra influenciada por su novio, hijo del líder obrero y por su medio hermano quien acusa al padrastro que lo quiere despojar de la fortuna heredada de su padre.

programme.title: El Corazón y la Espada
programme.desc: En Granada, la obsesión por el dinero hace que una mujer invierta su tiempo, sus ahorros y sus energías en encontrar a un misterioso alquimista que ha descubierto la fórmula para obtener oro en cualquier lugar y de forma rápida.

programme.desc: La Fierecilla Domada de Shakespeare es la base argumental de esta película. La acción y los personajes se transladan a un pequeño pueblo rural de la costa mexicana y la acción se adereza con números musicales basados en el folklore local.

programme.title: Más Fuerte Que El Amor
programme.desc: La joven y malcriada hija de un ambicioso industrial, lleva relaciones con hombre que se casará con ella por interés. Ella se enamora apasionadamente de antiguo trabajador de fábrica quien ha llegado a convertirse en uno de los principales socios.

programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes enfrenta un enredo amoroso. Uno de ellos, un joven limpiabotas, está perdidamente enamorado de una chica, pero ella ama a otro, quien, a su vez, está interesado en alguien más.

programme.title: Santo En La Venganza De La Momia
programme.desc: Santo se une a una expedición en busca de las ruinas indígenas Opalche. En el viaje lo acompaña unos exploradores. Pronto se encuentran la tumba momificada de Nonoc. Al entrar en la tumba, serán maldecidos por los espíritus que habitan en ella.

programme.title: Patrulla de Valientes
programme.desc: Un ranchero mexicano envía a su hijo para la Guardia Forestal Mexicana tal como sirvió él en su juventud. El hijo se involucra en un escándalo de corrupción con la Guardia de Seguridad de la gobernación, sin dimensionar las consecuencias.

programme.title: Los Campeones Justicieros
programme.desc: Cinco superhéroes (Blue Demon, Mil Máscaras, El Médico Asesino, La Sombra Vengadora y Tinieblas) se unen para luchar contra un científico loco y su ejército de poderosos enanos luchadores.

programme.title: La Isla de los Dinosaurios
programme.desc: En el intento por demostrar que la Antlántida aun existe, un profesor y sus alumnos se aventuran, en un viaje que los llevará a un lugar detenido en el tiempo.

programme.title: El Conde de Montecristo
programme.desc: Edmundo Dantés es falsamente acusado por los celos de otros por su buena fortuna y es condenado a pasar el resto de su vida en la famosa prisión de la isla, Chateau d'lf. Mientras encarcelado, se encuentra con Abbe Faria, un compañero de prisión a quien todo el mundo cree que estar loco. Abbe Faria le dice a Edmundo de un tesoro fantástico escondido en una pequeña isla que sólo él conoce la ubicación. Después de muchos años de prisión, el viejo Abbe muere y Edmundo escapa disfrazado como el cuerpo. Ahora libre, Edmundo debe encontrar el tesoro de Abbe le contó, para que pueda vengarze de aquellos que lo han hecho mal.

programme.desc: Martín quiere renunciar a su trabajo y comenzar su propia empresa después de casarse con María Elena. En un ataque de ira el jefe de Martín roba su dinero y asegura que él mismo lo ha robado. Martín es arrestado y encarcelado.

programme.title: El Misterio del Carro Express
programme.desc: El detective de la policía y su valiente prometida, una reportera, persiguen a la banda que atracó un tren.

programme.title: Dicen Que Soy Comunista
programme.desc: Un obrero agobiado por la crisis económica y el encarecimiento de la vida encuentra accidentalmente la propaganda de un partido político, aparentemente de izquierda, que le convence para incorporarse a sus filas ya que defiende a la clase trabajadora.

programme.title: Las Momias de San Ángel
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados planean vivir en una antigua casa del barrio San Angel. El padre del novio le pide a Mil Máscara vigilar a la pareja. Quién está preparado para lo que les espera?

programme.title: Las Braceras
programme.desc: Con un propósito fijo, Rosario y Marcela deben hallar la manera de cruzar la frontera con Estados Unidos, evitando a policías corruptos que andan tras su pista con sed asesina.

programme.desc: Franky es un ladrón de diamantes que debe entregar un valioso ejemplar a su jefe Avi. Sin embargo, antes de hacerlo, se deja persuadir por un tal Boris para apostar en un combate ilegal de boxeo.

programme.desc: Su particular y arrolladora personalidad, le han servido a este mujeriego, robarle sonrisas y suspiros a tres comadres: una viuda, una casada y una soltera. Enredos y emociones nunca faltan en su vida.

programme.title: Los Valientes de Guerrero
programme.desc: El malo de la comadreja quiere llevarse bien con una mujer que le gusta, por lo que incrimina al héroe por un asesinato y luego organiza una turba de linchamiento contra él... todo para promover sus planes.

programme.desc: Los pasajeros de un avión cuyo vuelo ha sufrido un retraso se hospedan en un hotel. Llega una joven de pelo castaño, bebe en el bar varios vodkas para darse valor, se insinúa a un viajero y hace el amor con él. El viajero descubre con sorpresa que ella ha sacrificado su virginidad. programme.desc: Una historia de amor conmovedora y auténtica. Ellos tendrán que enfrentarse al mundo para aprovechar aquella noche.

programme.title: Con Amor de Muerte
programme.desc: Los pasajeros de un avión cuyo vuelo ha sufrido un retraso se hospedan en un hotel. Llega una joven de pelo castaño, bebe en el bar varios vodkas para darse valor, se insinúa a un viajero y hace el amor con él. El viajero descubre con sorpresa que ella ha sacrificado su virginidad. La joven no quiere dar su nombre ni saber el del viajero y se cerciora de que él seguirá su viaje, sin esperanzas de volverla a ver.

programme.title: La Fuerza De Los Humildes
programme.desc: Un acaudalado industrial se encuentra en conflicto con sus obreros. Su hija está en desacuerdo con los métodos del padre, pues se encuentra influenciada por su novio, hijo del líder obrero y por su medio hermano quien acusa al padrastro que lo quiere despojar de la fortuna heredada de su padre.

programme.title: Las Monjitas de Durango
programme.desc: Una banda de contrabandistas dirigida por Don Rodolfo y sus mejores hombres, serán el principal obstáculo de Daniel y Rubén, quienes idearán un gran plan para deshacerse de este personaje.

programme.title: Una Rosa Sobre El Ring
programme.desc: Después de matar accidentalmente a un rival en el ring, Rodrigo, "Máscara Negra", lucha con sus demonios internos y trata de ganarle al campeón de campeones Mil Máscaras, en un enfrentamiento final.

programme.title: Bandera rota
programme.desc: Tras filmar por accidente un crimen pasional, un grupo de jóvenes cineastas idea un insólito chantaje para obligar al asesino a cumplir causas sociales, desatando una sátira política llena de ingenio.

programme.title: El Corazón y la Espada
programme.desc: En Granada, la obsesión por el dinero hace que una mujer invierta su tiempo, sus ahorros y sus energías en encontrar a un misterioso alquimista que ha descubierto la fórmula para obtener oro en cualquier lugar y de forma rápida.

programme.title: El Increíble Profesor Zovek
programme.desc: Gracias a sus poderes, el profesor Zovek descubrirá que el número de muertos registrados en un accidente aéreo no corresponde a las cifras oficiales. Detrás de esto se halla la mano siniestra de un perverso científico.

programme.title: De Mujer a Mujer
programme.desc: El despecho, el amor, la sexualidad exaltada, el sudor y el crimen pasional se encuentran en esta historia de traiciones mutuas. Basado en un hecho sangriento sucedido en 1983 en las afueras de Caracas, conocido con el nombre de "El crimen del Guapo".

programme.title: A la Orilla de un Palmar
programme.desc: La Fierecilla Domada de Shakespeare es la base argumental de esta película. La acción y los personajes se transladan a un pequeño pueblo rural de la costa mexicana y la acción se adereza con números musicales basados en el folklore local.

programme.title: Más Fuerte Que El Amor
programme.desc: La joven y malcriada hija de un ambicioso industrial, lleva relaciones con hombre que se casará con ella por interés. Ella se enamora apasionadamente de antiguo trabajador de fábrica quien ha llegado a convertirse en uno de los principales socios.

programme.title: Peligros de Juventud
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes enfrenta un enredo amoroso. Uno de ellos, un joven limpiabotas, está perdidamente enamorado de una chica, pero ella ama a otro, quien, a su vez, está interesado en alguien más.

programme.title: Santo En La Venganza De La Momia
programme.desc: Santo se une a una expedición en busca de las ruinas indígenas Opalche. En el viaje lo acompaña unos exploradores. Pronto se encuentran la tumba momificada de Nonoc. Al entrar en la tumba, serán maldecidos por los espíritus que habitan en ella.

programme.title: Patrulla de Valientes
programme.desc: Un ranchero mexicano envía a su hijo para la Guardia Forestal Mexicana tal como sirvió él en su juventud. El hijo se involucra en un escándalo de corrupción con la Guardia de Seguridad de la gobernación, sin dimensionar las consecuencias.

programme.title: Los Campeones Justicieros
programme.desc: Cinco superhéroes (Blue Demon, Mil Máscaras, El Médico Asesino, La Sombra Vengadora y Tinieblas) se unen para luchar contra un científico loco y su ejército de poderosos enanos luchadores.

programme.title: La Isla de los Dinosaurios
programme.desc: En el intento por demostrar que la Antlántida aun existe, un profesor y sus alumnos se aventuran, en un viaje que los llevará a un lugar detenido en el tiempo.

programme.title: El Conde de Montecristo
programme.desc: Edmundo Dantés es falsamente acusado por los celos de otros por su buena fortuna y es condenado a pasar el resto de su vida en la famosa prisión de la isla, Chateau d'lf. Mientras encarcelado, se encuentra con Abbe Faria, un compañero de prisión a quien todo el mundo cree que estar loco. Abbe Faria le dice a Edmundo de un tesoro fantástico escondido en una pequeña isla que sólo él conoce la ubicación. Después de muchos años de prisión, el viejo Abbe muere y Edmundo escapa disfrazado como el cuerpo. Ahora libre, Edmundo debe encontrar el tesoro de Abbe le contó, para que pueda vengarze de aquellos que lo han hecho mal.

programme.title: INTERVYU NA RTVI s Mariannoy Minsker
programme.desc: Intervyu o politike, ekonomike i obschestve c Mariannoy Minsker. Razgovor s nyusmeykerami, ekspertami i intellektualami, kotorye opredelyayut povestku ili sposobny ee pereosmyslit. Ne stenogramma sobytiy, a popytka ponyat skrytye mehanizmy, stoyaschie za novostnymi zagolovkami.

programme.title: DEZHURNYY PO AMERIKE
programme.desc: Programma "Dezhurnyy po Amerike" rasshiryaet gorizonty. My ohvatyvaem vse aspekty zhizni v SSHA — ot politiki do svetskoy hroniki, ot ekonomiki do nauchnyh otkrytiy i prognoza pogody. Eto ne prosto novosti, a zhivye chelovecheskie istorii i glubokiy obzor stilya zhizni v Nyu-Yorke i po vsey strane.

programme.title: US: NOVOSTI
programme.desc: "US: Novosti" — eto dinamichnaya programma, osveschayuschaya klyuchevye sobytiya, formiruyuschie zhizn v Soedinyonnyh SHtatah. My predlagaem vsestoronniy obzor — ot politiki i ekonomiki do sotsialnyh voprosov, tehnologiy i kultury.

programme.title: US: OBSTOYATELSTVA
programme.desc: Analiticheskaya programma, posvyaschennaya aktualnym sobytiyam i klyuchevym voprosam, kotorye vliyayut na zhizn v Soedinyonnyh SHtatah. V kazhdom vypuske Liza Kaymin i odin iz veduschih RTVI US priglashayut ekspertov, chtoby predlozhit professionalnyy vzglyad na samye vazhnye novosti dnya i obsudit ih posledstviya dlya obschestva.

programme.title: INTERVYU NA RTVI
programme.desc: Ezhednevno v efire RTVI intervyu na temy, kotorye volnuyut obschestvo. Razbor sobytiy, prognozy ekspertov s glavnymi veduschimi RTVI.

programme.title: REDAKTSIYA
programme.desc: Syuzhety o lyudyah, sobytiyah i yavleniyah glazami nepredvzyatoy zhurnalistiki.

programme.title: Dokumentalnyy film "Soyuzmultfilm. Tolko dlya vzroslyh"
programme.desc: Pochemu vzroslye smotreli sovetskie multfilmy ne s menshim, a to i s bolshim interesom i udovolstviem, chem deti? Kakie dopolnitelnye smysly zashifrovyvali v svoih shedevrah mastera sovetskoy multiplikatsii? programme.title: MAKS PUTESHESTVUET
programme.desc: Eto Maks — i on puteshestvuet po samym interesnym mestam planety, snimaet istorii o lyudyah i delitsya poleznymi sovetami dlya teh, kto lyubit otkryvat novoe. V kazhdom vypuske velichie prirody, atmosfernye ugolki raznyh stran i unikalnye traditsii mest raskryvayut svoi tayny i udivitelnye storony, prevraschaya kazhdyy marshrut v nezabyvaemoe puteshestvie!

programme.title: Drobyshevskiy
programme.desc: Nauchnaya programma o proishozhdenii cheloveka — prostym yazykom. Vmeste s populyarnym antropologom Stanislavom Drobyshevskim razbiraemsya v evolyutsii cheloveka: ot sahelyantropov i ardipitekov do hobbitov i denisovtsev. Kak nashi predki osvaivali zemlyu, kto stal nashim pryamym predkom i pochemu, kakoy byla ih povsednevnaya zhizn, moral i otnosheniya v kamennom veke.

programme.title: EKSPERT PLYUS
programme.desc: «Ekspert plyus» — eto intervyu s ekspertami v samyh raznyh oblastyah nauki i kultury. Vy uzhe videli ih v programme «Drobyshevskiy plyus», no, uvy, mnogo tsennogo ostalos za kadrom. Samoe vremya eto ispravit.
